name: TrailMixer
tagline: Upload messy event footage and get an AI-edited trailer with matching music, then fine-tune it.

awards: TwelveLabs: Best Use of TwelveLabs API (Podium)

problem: Creators and events need recap videos fast.
solution: Video understanding picks meaningful clips, stitches them to a chosen length, adds music matched by sentiment, and offers a simple editor.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a day of clips and get a 30-second trailer.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “TwelveLabs: Best Use of TwelveLabs API (Podium)” among 131 submissions.
Made recaps for the hackathon itself.

lessons: Using the event's own footage in the demo makes it personal for judges.
